description:
Native iOS XCFramework wrapper for Stripe Terminal Tap to Pay functionality.
      Provides a simplified Objective-C interface for .NET MAUI iOS bindings.
      
      Includes:
      - DCStripeTapToPayWrapper.xcframework (custom wrapper)
      - StripeTerminal.xcframework (Stripe Terminal SDK v5.x)
      
      Requires iOS 15.4 or later.
summary: Stripe Terminal Tap to Pay wrapper for .NET MAUI iOS applications
title: Dispatch Connect - Stripe Tap to Pay for iOS
